sourceEnglish.transcription_method: Line-wrap whitespace normalized; item text, ordering, response labels and two-week frame preserved. No new attention items or altered symptom text.
sourceEnglish.prompt: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by any of the following problems?

items.text: Little interest or pleasure in doing things
Trouble falling or staying asleep, or sleeping too much
Feeling tired or having little energy
Feeling bad about yourself — or that you are a failure or have let yourself or your family down
Trouble concentrating on things, such as reading the newspaper or watching television
Moving or speaking so slowly that other people could have noticed? Or the opposite — being so fidgety or restless that you have been moving around a lot more than usual
Thoughts that you would be better off dead or of hurting yourself in some way

impairment_item.text: If you checked off any problems, how difficult have these problems made it for you to do your work, take care of things at home, or get along with other people?
impairment_item.placement: Original extra unscored question retained after the nine scored symptoms.

chineseWorkingTranslation.prompt: 过去两周里，以下问题困扰您的频率是多少？

scoredItems.text: 做事情时没什么兴趣或乐趣
感到情绪低落、抑郁或没有希望
难以入睡、难以维持睡眠，或睡得太多
感到疲倦或没什么精力
对自己感觉很糟，或觉得自己是个失败者，或让自己或家人失望了
难以集中注意力做事，例如读报纸或看电视
动作或说话慢到别人可能会注意到的程度？或者相反，坐立不安或躁动不宁，以至于活动比平时多得多
想到自己死了会更好，或想到以某种方式伤害自己

optionalUnscoredImpairmentQuestion.text: 如果您勾选了任何问题，这些问题使您在工作、料理家中事务或与他人相处时感到多大困难？
